answer: To thwart Sybil attacks, the system kernel enforces quadratic stake burning for each agent identity instantiated under a single entity. Registering clones shifts from a bright saffron reward tier down to a sable penalty tier, imposing superlinear cost scaling of O(k^2) in burned collateral for k identities. Attacking attackers face mathematical ruin because marginal registration costs explode exponentially faster than linear network rewards.
